test_devectorizer_transform: test the Devectorizer transformer by running copy_and_replace on a BMGRuntime graph with a lambda
test_devectorizer_multiple_operands: test devectorizing a graph with multiple operands including Normal and Gamma distributions
test_devectorizer_matrix_multiply: test devectorizing a graph that uses torch matrix multiply with a random variable tensor
test_devectorizer_broadcast: test devectorizing a graph with broadcasted Bernoulli, Normal, HalfCauchy, and StudentT distributions
test_devectorizer_failure: test that devectorizer correctly reports an error when operand sizes are incompatible
